description: This file defines interfaces and conditional compilation directives for map averaging functionality in engine control software. It declares functions related to ADC callback handling, initialization, pre-calculation refresh, and post-map state updates, conditioned on various compile-time configurations.

methods.name: mapAveragingAdcCallback
methods.description: Handles new ADC sample values for map averaging, called when ADC callback occurs.

methods.name: initMapAveraging
methods.description: Initializes map averaging subsystem with logging and engine context.

methods.name: refreshMapAveragingPreCalc
methods.description: Recomputes pre-calculated values related to map averaging, parameters depend on engine state.

methods.name: postMapState
methods.description: Updates output channels after map state changes for tuning and diagnostics.
